name: Selkirk Montessori School

geo.coord_source: BC Ministry school-location dataset 2025/2026 (DataBC geocode of the registered address)

description: Non-profit Montessori school (Pacific Montessori Society, since 1992) in Victoria from preschool to Grade 8, following the full B.C. curriculum with Montessori methodology. Group 1 independent school; also hosts a Montessori teacher-training institute.

attributes.philosophy: 'Contemporary Montessori': mixed-age classrooms, hands-on materials, research and project-based learning, service learning and field studies.

legal_status.label: Independent school, Group 1 (Independent School Act, B.C.)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care — Independent Schools Branch

attributes.curriculum: Full B.C. curriculum through Montessori methodology; French, music, PE specialists.

tuition.notes: 2025-26 Schedule of Fees (PDF): Kindergarten full day $11,534; Levels 1–8 $11,486; preschool $13,480 before CCFRI rebate. The current tuition web page (school year not labelled, presumably 2026-27) shows K $12,110 and Elementary & Middle $12,060. Sibling discounts 15% / 30%.

attributes.additional_fees: Supply & activity $156–$1,663 by grade; one-time new-student fees $450; mortgage retirement fund minimum $350/yr; before/after care $1,700–$3,400/yr.
attributes.admission: Expression of interest and application via the school site.
attributes.class_size: Low student-teacher ratios stated; numbers not published.
advantages: Montessori continues to Grade 8, well past early childhood
Moderate fees for an urban Montessori school
Teacher-training institute on site signals method depth
limitations: Latest dated fee schedule is 2025-26; 2026-27 figures on the web page carry no year label
attributes.qualifying_reason: Private Group 1 school with Montessori to Grade 8; register and official site read; latest dated tuition (2025-26) recorded with its year and the unlabelled current figure noted.
